d:
Celebrate this Ganesh Utsav with Salman Khan, Aayush Sharma and Varun Dhawan as they seek blessings in the first song from Antim, ‘Vighnaharta!’
Directed by Mahesh V Manjrekar
Produced by Salma Khan
Song: Vighnaharta
Singer: Ajay Gogavale
Music: Hitesh Modak
Lyrics: Vaibhav Joshi
Song arranged, composed and produced by: Hitesh Modak
